newsitem.title: USA: Windmere-Durable sees sales, earnings accelerating.
newsitem.headline: Windmere-Durable sees sales, earnings accelerating.

text.p: Windmere-Durable Holdings Inc said Wednesday it expects sales and earnings momentum to accelerate in the second half of the year as it continues to benefit from its new strategic direction in the consumer products industry.
The company also said the second half is historically the strongest part of its year.

"When we began the year, we were confident that our efforts to reinvent Windmere-Durable had positioned us to become a more formidable competitor in the consumer products industry," the company said in a prepared statement.
The company reported a second quarter profit per share of $0.10 on 19 percent more shares versus a loss of $0.03 per share.
The company said second quarter improvements were companywide, and included strong growth in manufacturing sales and substantial progress in marketing initiatives for its LitterMaid product.
